terms.definition: A membrane sac filled with enzymes that breaks down waste and old cell parts.
terms.function: Digests and recycles materials to keep the cell clean.
terms.whereItIs: Scattered in the cytoplasm, made from Golgi packages.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the cell's cleanup and recycling crew.

terms.definition: A protein that speeds up chemical reactions, like breaking down waste.
terms.function: Cuts large molecules into smaller pieces.
terms.whereItIs: Filling the inside of the lysosome.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the powerful tools that do the actual digesting.

terms.definition: Recovering the useful small pieces left after digestion.
terms.function: Returns reusable molecules to the cell.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets the cell save and reuse its own materials.
